question: Two careful engineers implementing this rule independently, with only this contract, would produce DIFFERENT behavior on some input (the rule is ambiguous, under-specified, or relies on unstated host facts).

rules.text: An empty units list yields EMPTY_REPORT (PINNED) followed by the STOPS block of R5 (which is empty unless stops is at least 1).

A row PASSES exactly when its status equals the text "pass" (exact comparison: case-sensitive, no trimming). Every other status, the empty text and "fail" included, FAILS. F = the number of failing rows, N = the number of rows. CITED FIDELITY package — the status fails closed: "PASS", "pass " and "error" all count as failing

For N at least 1 the heading is "## SIR review: " followed by the VERDICT of TABLE VERDICT. NOUN is "contract" when N is 1 and "contracts" otherwise; it follows N in both rows (so "1 of 2 contracts failing", "1 of 1 contract failing").

Each row, in input order, renders as ROW (PINNED): the icon is FAIL_ICON for a failing row and PASS_ICON for a passing one (R2); each of the five cells is CELL(field), defined in four steps. (a) T = the field's text scanned left to right with each match of TABLE CELL_ESCAPE replaced; a CR immediately followed by an LF is one match (one space), any other CR or LF is a match on its own; every other character is kept. (b) An empty T is the empty cell (CELL is the empty text). (c) K = the length of the longest run of consecutive backticks (U+0060) in T, 0 when there is none; FENCE = K + 1 backticks. (d) PAD = one space (U+0020) when T begins with a backtick, or ends with a backtick, or begins with a space and ends with a space and holds at least one character outside TRIM_SPACE (PINNED); otherwise PAD is empty. CELL = FENCE PAD T PAD FENCE. No other character is altered or escaped. CITED FIDELITY package — the fence rule is CommonMark's; the all-space test is the host's trim set, not CommonMark's

The STOPS block is chosen by TABLE STOPS_LINE. A count renders as its decimal digits, no grouping, no plus sign, no exponent, at any magnitude of the i64 range. A zero or negative count yields no block.

For N at least 1 the result is REPORT (PINNED): the heading, a blank line, the two fixed table lines, the rows joined by single LFs, a final LF, then the STOPS block when there is one (a blank line, the stops line, and a final LF).
F at least 1 -> FAIL_ICON " " F " of " N " " NOUN " failing"
F is 0       -> PASS_ICON " " N " " NOUN " passing"
stops at most 0  -> no block (the empty text)
stops is 1       -> LF stops " Stop" STOPS_TAIL LF
stops at least 2 -> LF stops " Stops" STOPS_TAIL LF
CR LF (U+000D U+000A, as a pair)  -> " " (one space)
